Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Abandoning the Fortunes
Cards.Text: Until the game ends, before each player's turn ends, if his Dynasty deck has no cards, he chooses and destroys one Personality or Holding he controls for each of his provinces without a Dynasty card in it.

Cards.Name: Alter History
Cards.Text: After the next time this game you destroy a province as the Attacker, the Defender loses 5 Honor. If this loss brings him below his starting Family Honor, then until the game ends, he may ignore Honor Requirements when bringing Personalities into play.

Cards.Name: Benefices of the Emperor
Cards.Text: Each player in turn order starting with you may choose a card in his hand. Discard all chosen cards. If exactly one player's card has the lowest Focus Value of all those cards, he gains a province to the left of his leftmost province. If exactly one player's card has the highest Focus Value of all those cards, permanently increase his maximum hand size by three, and he draws three cards.

Cards.Name: Boastful Proclamation
Cards.Text: If any other player controls a Personality, then at the start of your next turn, if this province still exists, permanently give it +3 strength and gain 3 Honor. Until your next turn begins, after battle resolution destroys this province, give each Personality in the attacking army a +1F token and the Attacker may draw a card.

Cards.Name: Cherry Blossom Festival
Cards.Text: No players may take Reactions until your next Events Phase begins.

Cards.Name: Delayed Arrival
Cards.Text: Choose a Personality in play. He may not be assigned to attack you until your next turn begins.

Cards.Name: Disgrace
Cards.Text: Until your Events Phase two turns from now begins, other players may not target your Personalities with Limited actions.

Cards.Name: Glory of the Shogun
Cards.Text: Until the game ends, equipping is a Battle/Open action (for all players), and after the first time each turn each player attaches a card with a base Gold Cost of 5 or more from his hand, that player may draw a card.

Cards.Name: Moon and Sun
Cards.Text: Each player may shuffle an Event in his discard pile into his deck.

Cards.Name: Naoharu's Gift
Cards.Text: Show a card in your hand to another player. You offer it as a gift. He may put it in his hand; if he does, you gain Honor equal to its base Focus Value. If you showed a card and he did not put it in his hand, discard the card and draw two cards.

Cards.Name: Rebuilding the Empire
Cards.Text: Any player with three or fewer provinces may gain a province to the right of his rightmost province. Each player who gained a province from this has his Family Honor lowered to its starting value, and he may not declare an attack until your next turn begins. This Honor loss will not be negated or given to another player instead.

Cards.Name: Successful Bounty
Cards.Text: Until your Events Phase three turns from now begins, after each time a Personality opposing a Magistrate or Courtier becomes dishonorable from an action, the Personality's controller loses 2 Honor.
